parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: AddressPoolId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description:
The enabled status of the address pool:

- enable: Enables the address pool. If the health check is normal, the address pool is included in DNS resolution.

- disable: Disables the address pool. The address pool is not included in DNS resolution, regardless of its health check status.
